Origin and meaning

Sadie comes from Hebrew and means “princess (diminutive of Sarah)”.

About the name Sadie

A Hebrew diminutive of Sarah that has become a favourite in its own right.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Sadie as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “princess (diminutive of Sarah)”, is part of the appeal.
